caption: The drawing depicts a piece of yellow fabric, irregular in shape, displayed on a plain light background. The fabric features embroidered floral designs, with a prominent central flower in deep red and surrounding green leaves and stems. Smaller flowers and buds in red and blue, along with green leafy elements, are scattered across the fabric. Decorative stitching is present along the edges in various colors such as blue, pink, and red, forming patterns and borders. The stitches and floral embroidery exhibit different textures and thread thicknesses, giving the fabric a layered appearance. The overall color palette consists of yellow as the base, with accents of red, green, blue, and pink from the embroidery threads. The fabric appears to be positioned horizontally and occupies the central portion of the drawing, with ample blank space around it.
title: Patchwork Quilt (Section)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
